description: This file contains implementation details for the 'absl::AnyInvocable' class template, including internal type traits, storage management, invocation mechanisms, and specializations for various function qualifiers. It defines the internal structure and behavior for a type-erased, callable wrapper supporting small object optimization and remote storage.

classes.name: AnyInvocable
classes.description: A template class for type-erased, invocable objects supporting small object optimization and remote storage.

methods.name: InvokeR
methods.description: Internal helper to invoke a callable with a specified return type, handling void and non-void cases.

methods.name: ObjectInLocalStorage
methods.description: Accesses the stored object in local storage with proper launder or cast.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the internal storage with a given callable, deciding between local and remote storage.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored callable with provided arguments, with support for various cv/ref qualifiers and noexcept specifications.
